rem Mixtures
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=478

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg N integer = 10000000

rem P counts primitive triples in
rem 0..N^3, H(L) = 1 + coprime x, y > 0
rem with x + L y <= N, and E = 2^P - 1
rem - 2^h B + sum 6 phi(L) 2^(h -
rem H(L)), h = (P - 1) / 2, B = 6 sum
rem phi. Powers of 2 mod 11^8 reduce
rem their exponent mod phi(11^8).
Md = 214358881
Fh = 194871710
rem mu and phi by small primes; the
rem cofactor in Rs is one big prime.
fun N sieve
  Mu = array shape (N + 1) fill 1
  Mu 0 = 0
  Ph = 0 to N copy
  Rs = 0 to N copy
  Rt = N isqrt
  Primes = primes to Rt copy
  Size = Primes len
  Index = 0
  Power = 2
  for Index less Size
    P = Primes Index
    Sl = Power to N by Power
    Rs Sl //= P
    if Power equal P
      Mu Sl *= -1
      Ph Sl -= Ph Sl // P
      Square = P * P
      Mu (Square to N by Square) = 0
    end
    Power *= P
    if Power greater N
      Index += 1
      if Index less Size
        Power = Primes Index
      end
    end
  end
  Bp = Rs greater 1
  Mu = Bp choose (0 - Mu) Mu
  Rm = Rs max 1
  Ph = Bp choose (Ph // Rm * (Rm - 1)) Ph
  Mt = Mu scan +
  return tuple Mt Ph
end
unpack Mt Ph = N sieve
rem Moebius sums group by m = N // d:
rem Cm is the sum of mu over those d.
Sn = N isqrt
D1 = 1 to Sn copy
Ms = (N // (Sn + 1)) to 1 by -1
Ms = concat (N // D1) Ms
Ms = Ms unique
Cm = Mt (N // Ms) - Mt (N // (Ms + 1))
P3 = Cm * ((Ms + 1) ** 3 - 1)
Pt = P3 sum
rem H(L) - 1 = sum over m of Cm G(m,
rem L), G the pairs a, b > 0 with a +
rem L b <= m: q m - L q (q + 1) / 2.
fun N counts Ms Cm
  Hs = array shape (N + 1) fill 1
  Size = Ms len
  for I in 0 till Size
    C = Cm I
    if C not equal 0
      M = Ms I
      Lr = 1 to M
      Q = M // Lr
      G = Q * M - Lr * Q * (Q + 1) // 2
      Hs (1 to M) += C * G
    end
  end
  return Hs
end
Hs = N counts Ms Cm
rem 2^e mod Md from two tables.
Hf = (Pt - 1) // 2 mod Fh
Ex = (Hf - Hs (1 to N)) mod Fh
E0 = 0 till 16384 copy
T0 = 2 E0 Md powmod
Tb = 2 16384 Md powmod
E1 = 0 to Fh // 16384 copy
T1 = Tb E1 Md powmod
Pw = T0 (Ex mod 16384)
Pw = Pw * (T1 (Ex // 16384)) mod Md
P1 = Ph (1 to N)
Tw = (6 * P1 mod Md) * Pw mod Md
Tt = Tw sum mod Md
Bn = 6 * (P1 sum) mod Md
F = 2 (Hf mod Fh) Md powmod
F = (1 + F * Bn - Tt) mod Md
Answer = 2 (Pt mod Fh) Md powmod
Answer = (Answer - F) mod Md
Answer print
